---
title: "Cladistic analysis of Maya king lists"
format: html
---

```{r dependencies}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r data-king-lists}
king_lists <- read_xlsx("data/king-lists.xlsx", col_types = "text") |>
  select(-c(archetype, ...16)) |>
  pivot_longer(!c(Ruler, variants), names_to = "specimen") |>
  mutate(
    value = replace_na(value, "―"), # character absent
    value = na_if(value, "#"),# 
    value = na_if(value, "?") # lemmas
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = specimen, names_from = c(Ruler, variants))
```

```{r dist}
# TODO: where do the NAs come from?
dist(column_to_rownames(king_lists, "specimen"), method = "manhattan")
# TODO: try Hamming (from cultevo) - more sensible NA handling
```
